title: Third gate-count component
statement: For natural numbers $n$ and $k$, define $c(n,k)=f(n,k)+2^{2^k}$, where $f(n,k)=z(n,k)+(2^{k+1}-1)$ and $z(n,k)=n+(2^{n-k+1}-1)$; subtraction in the exponent defining $z$ is truncated natural-number subtraction.
